MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The Gigabit Ethernet switch feels like a useful next choice after my USB Gigabit Ethernet adapter because it could help me connect more devices by wire with simple setup.",
    "The wired earbuds fit my past interest in a headset with a microphone, although that interest alone would not make me buy another pair without a replacement need."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "The smart speaker and streaming devices do not help with the practical computer connection needs behind my recent purchases.",
    "My DVI cable and small tablet mount do not establish a need for HDMI cables or a television wall mount; the connection type and device being supported matter to me.",
    "The USB hard drive connects in a familiar way, but that does not mean I need more storage."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "The recommendations seem to treat buying computer accessories as a broad interest in home entertainment electronics.",
    "Shared words such as cable, USB, or mount seem to count too much when the items serve different purposes."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "My most recent purchase points toward wired networking, which makes expanding Ethernet connections more relevant than adding streaming features.",
    "I buy accessories occasionally to meet specific needs, so a related item needs a clear use rather than merely resembling something I already own.",
    "Exact connector and device compatibility matter: owning a DVI cable does not tell you that I need HDMI or Micro HDMI."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "You partly recognized my interest in practical accessories but stretched it into entertainment purchases without enough evidence of a current need."
}
